Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Diablo 3D source-based candidate bow study, not runtime art.
Reconstruct ONLY the ONE physical bow in the private attached ICURS 133 reference for item.design.base.composite-bow. The name does not authorize redesign. The bow is reddish-brown wood, broad silver-gray reinforcing plates on the long upper/left limb and lower/right limb, with exposed red wood between plates, small gold/ochre bindings, silver hooked tips and a thin dull olive string. Preserve the irregular unequal-looking plate segmentation and source overall curve; no arrow, no added ornate grip.
Produce a clean realistic HD modeling sheet, charcoal-gray background and soft neutral studio light, restrained physically plausible wood/metal/string texture with no painted floor shadow. Four complete well-separated views of the SAME object labeled FRONT, SIDE, BACK, 3-4 plus a smaller NEW HD ICON thumbnail. Title COMPOSITE BOW. FRONT is full bow plane, SIDE is genuine thin edge-on profile, BACK is opposite face rotated 180 degrees around vertical and therefore horizontally mirrors the curved full silhouette of FRONT. Preserve limbs, tip curves, color blocks, grip, fittings, string nocks and a single taut string in ALL views and the new thumbnail. The 3-4 thumbnail may match native angle but must be newly painted realistic HD, NEVER source pixels. No source sprite inset. No hands, person, scenery, arrows, name/power-derived enchantments, glow, labels on the object or multiple designs. Unseen cross section, back fittings, grip construction and material readings are cautious inferences, keep them minimal. Layout clean and useful for later modeling; this is candidate documentation, not an approved turnaround or finished model.

Subject: Fool's Crest; item.design.unique.fool-s-crest; native cursor 80.
A snug medieval jester FOOL'S CREST cap/mask in alternating dark RED and muted BLUE cloth panels, TWO long drooping curved side lobes (red on viewer-left, blue on viewer-right) each ending in a small brass/gold bell/fitting. Preserve the central close-fitting red/blue forehead and two oval dark empty eye cutouts, separated by a narrow central fabric nose piece; the lower face is open/absent. No actual face or eyes inside, no smile, hair, additional third/fourth jester points or bright neon. Cloth folds and hidden seams are proposed.

entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Diablo 3D candidate item study based strictly on private attached ICURS 138, item.design.unique.nightscape. The unique name/powers do not authorize redesign. The source is a LONG dark indigo/blue-gray coat or robe family, not a generic cloak or multicolored rainbow: dark blue long sleeves, small ochre-gold flared cuffs, broad ornate ochre upper-chest/shoulder yoke with curled upward shoulder tips and dark recessed motifs, prominent small RED center chest fastener/gem, broad dark/gold waist belt with raised central ochre block, long blue-gray split lower panels with ochre borders, angular gold-edged front flap ending in a long ochre pendant/point, and muted ochre edging near bottom hem. Preserve this exact long silhouette, black-blue cloth and gold structures, no hood, cape redesign, rainbow gradient or name/power-derived magic.
Produce EXACTLY FIVE separate complete newly painted realistic HD depictions: four large views FRONT (native source face), SIDE (90-degree true profile), BACK (opposite physical rear surface), 3-4 (45 degrees showing front AND side, distinct from SIDE), then fifth smaller matching inventory ICON below/right. Never merge 3-4/ICON. Every view includes the same complete set and identical color blocks, curves, lengths and ornament/fastener placements. BACK must show a minimal plausible rear of same object, NOT copy the front chest fastener/ornament onto the back unless actually required by physical construction. Keep all source pieces in frame, separated. Charcoal gray background, neutral soft studio light, restrained realistic candidate metal/textile/leather, no painted floor shadow. No character, body, head, mannequin, hands, skin, support stand, scenery, weapons, spell lettering, glow or source sprite inset. ICON is NEW HD art, never native pixels. Rear, thickness, attachment, red detail material and hardware construction are cautious inferences. No class redesign, rig or runtime deliverable; unapproved art study.

It is a larger arrangement than small ICURS4 and source medium5, not a treasure mountain. Match THIS source footprint, squat height, partial stacked edges and overlap topology. Occluded total coin number cannot be recovered exactly; do not invent a printed quantity, do not imply one depicted coin equals one unit of gold. Do NOT redesign from name or scale up/reuse the small pile. Keep arrangement native-source based, neutral color, simple material.
EXACTLY FIVE separate realistic HD depictions of the SAME stable pile: four large views FRONT (elevated view near source angle), SIDE (true low profile to see thickness/stack), BACK (opposite elevated side), 3-4 (different elevated angle showing same arrangement), plus fifth small NEW HD ICON at the original inventory angle. All complete separated on charcoal-gray background with soft neutral studio light, no dramatic glow or painted floor shadow. Label FRONT/SIDE/BACK/3-4/ICON only, never combine 3-4/ICON. Count and adjacency cannot change between views: rotate the same pile as one group, don't rearrange or add coins for BACK/ICON. Rear surfaces, exact thickness, faint rim and unseen overlaps are cautious proposed inferences. No bags, chests, large mountain, scenery, lettering, magic, sprites or source-pixel inset.
